    bottom_sources = [(r,c,v) for r,c,v in positions if r == height-1]
    left_sources = [(r,c,v) for r,c,v in positions if c == 0]
    right_sources = [(r,c,v) for r,c,v in positions if c == width-1]
    
    # Step 1: HORIZONTAL rays (complete fill, overwrite empty cells)
    # Left-to-right
    for r, c, val in left_sources:
        for j in range(c + 1, width):
            result[r][j] = val
    
    # Right-to-left  
    for r, c, val in right_sources:
        for j in range(c - 1, -1, -1):
            result[r][j] = val
    
    # Step 2: VERTICAL rays (stop at ANY different non-zero)
    # Top-to-bottom

# Maybe blocking is VALUE-BASED: a ray can pass through matching value, stops at different
# AND rays are mutually blocking - once a cell has ANY ray, others stop

def solve_mutual_blocking(input_grid):
    height = len(input_grid)
    width = len(input_grid[0])
    
    result = [[input_grid[r][c] for c in range(width)] for r in range(height)]
    
    positions = []
    for r in range(height):
        for c in range(width):
            if input_grid[r][c] != 0:
                positions.append((r, c, input_grid[r][c]))
    
    top_sources = [(r,c,v) for r,c,v in positions if r == 0]
    bottom_sources = [(r,c,v) for r,c,v in positions if r == height-1]
    left_sources = [(r,c,v) for r,c,v in positions if c == 0]
    right_sources = [(r,c,v) for r,c,v in positions if c == width-1]
    
    # Fire ALL rays in order until stable
    changed = True
    while changed:
        changed = False
        changed_vd = changed_vu = changed_hr = changed_hl = False
        
        # Vertical DOWN - can only write to 0 or match current value
        for r, c, val in top_sources:
            i = r + 1
            while i < height:
                curr = result[i][c]
                if curr != 0 and curr != val:
                    break
                result[i][c] = val
                changed_vd = True
                i += 1
        
        # Vertical UP
        for r, c, val in bottom_sources:
            i = r - 1
            while i >= 0:
                curr = result[i][c]
                if curr != 0 and curr != val:
                    break
                result[i][c] = val
                changed_vu = True
                i -= 1
        
        # Horizontal RIGHT  
        for r, c, val in left_sources:
            j = c + 1
            while j < width:
                curr = result[r][j]
                if curr != 0 and curr != val:
                    break
                result[r][j] = val
                changed_hr = True
                j += 1
        
        # Horizontal LEFT
        for r, c, val in right_sources:
            j = c - 1
            while j >= 0:
                curr = result[r][j]
                if curr != 0 and curr != val:
                    break
                result[r][j] = val
                changed_hl = True
                j -= 1
        
        changed = changed_vd or changed_vu or changed_hr or changed_hl
    
    return result
